rules: Retain original genuine marking and record identity. Display suffixes are not new designations or SKUs.
Use the smallest meaningful source-backed distinction; keep additional electrical differences in distinguishingAttributes with useInLabel=false.

Families remain visibly labeled series; references stay reference-kind records.
Source conflicts remain explicit; no source fields are corrected or overwritten.
Typography check applies Unicode NFKC, casefolding, dash folding and removal of whitespace, without altering the source or output designations.
